Tumours with higher ESR1 mRNA expression show longer overall survival than those in the lowest quartile of ER-positive breast cancer.

ESR1 levels matter for prognosis in breast cancer.

Tumours with higher ESR1 mRNA expression.librarian: SUPPORTED - Passages link high ER expression levels to better outcomes in ER-positive cohorts.
Tumours with higher ESR1 mRNA expression.critic: SOUND - Specific, testable against TCGA survival data, and consistent with the ranked passages.

High ESR1 expression predicts greater be.librarian: SUPPORTED - ER level is described as a predictor of endocrine response in the retrieved work.
High ESR1 expression predicts greater be.critic: SOUND - Clear direction and a measurable treatment outcome; passages are on topic.

ESR1 expression is associated with lower.librarian: UNCLEAR - No retrieved passage reports Ki-67 against ESR1 level directly.
ESR1 expression is associated with lower.critic: SHAKY - Plausible, but the passages never measure proliferation, so nothing here supports it.

Activating ESR1 mutations in metastatic.librarian: SUPPORTED - Several passages discuss ESR1-mutated advanced disease and endocrine resistance.
Activating ESR1 mutations in metastatic.critic: SHAKY - This is about mutations, not expression level, so it drifts from the question asked.

ESR1 levels matter for prognosis in brea.librarian: UNCLEAR - Too broad to match against any specific passage.
